title: Fatherhood, Perinatal Care, Support Networks & Mental Health Planning
description: SS-CURR-001 & SS-CURR-003: Covers pregnancy and newborn fourth-trimester care, accountable fatherhood and positive role modelling, building informal and formal support networks, mental health crisis planning, and safe AI coach skills.
outcomes: Support maternal, paternal, and infant wellbeing across pregnancy, the fourth trimester, and early infancy
Practise accountable, non-violent fatherhood and build a reliable village of informal and professional supports
Create clear mental-health and crisis support plans and use the SafeSteps AI Support Coach safely within privacy boundaries
